# dsh-setting-restart
One-click restart of the DSH service, from **Settings → General**. The "一键重启" row is pinned at the v
ery bottom of the General settings page — no matter how many rows are added above it later, it alway
s stays the last one. After the restart the page reconnects automatically and the row confirms it wi
th a green "Connected" state, so you always know the service is back.
## Features
- A **one-click restart** row at the bottom of **Settings → General** (below "繁忙时 Enter 键行为" / whate

ver comes last).
- The row is pinned with the maximum slot `order`, so it always renders at the bott

om of the page.
- Restart is a real process restart: the host spawns a detached helper, exits, and t
he helper re-spawns the exact same `dsh` command (same executable, arguments, cwd and environment).

The browser tab reconnects automatically once the new instance binds the same port.
- Bilingual UI c

opy (简体中文 / English), following the DSH client conventions.
- Fully typed host invocation through th
e DSH Typert RPC registry (`settingRestart/restart`).
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `dsh` ≥ 0.1.0-rc.6 (the `web` profile).
- Node.js ≥ 20.
